claims.text: The hotel is on Lam Son Square, a short walk from the Saigon Opera House, the Central Post Office and Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon.

findings.quote: Situated on Lam Son Square, the hotel is just a quick walk from Saigon Opera House, the Central Post Office and Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon.

claims.text: The hotel's 2005 debut marked Hyatt's first foray in Vietnam.

findings.quote: Its 2005 debut marked Hyatt’s first foray in Vietnam

claims.text: The French colonial building has an ivory-colored facade that matches the Saigon Opera House next door.

findings.quote: The French colonial building is a homage to the city’s history, with an ivory-colored façade that matches the Saigon Opera House next door.

claims.text: Black-and-white photographs and lacquer paintings by Vietnamese artists hang on the walls, courtesy of Ben Thanh Art Gallery.

findings.quote: Black-and-white photographs and priceless lacquer paintings by Vietnamese artists adorn the walls, courtesy of Ben Thanh Art Gallery.

claims.text: The suites have a separate living room and a curated collection of oil paintings, antiques, lacquerware and handcrafted embroidery by established Vietnamese artists.

findings.quote: the suites at Park Hyatt Saigon feature a separate living room, as well as a curated collection of oil paintings, antiques, lacquerware and handcrafted embroidery by established Vietnamese artists.

claims.text: Park Deluxe rooms have a private terrace with direct access to the pool and garden.

findings.quote: This 41 sq m (441 sq ft) room, also known as Park Deluxe, offers a private terrace with direct access to the elegant pool and lush garden.

claims.text: Square One is the hotel's signature restaurant, combining French gastronomy with Vietnamese flavours.

findings.quote: Square One, signature restaurant of Park Hyatt Saigon, marrying the finesse of French gastronomy with the vibrancy of Vietnamese flavours.

claims.text: Opera, guided by Chef Luca Cappellato, serves Italian cooking.

findings.quote: Guided by Chef Luca Cappellato, Opera celebrates the art of Italian cooking with refined techniques and the finest ingredients.

claims.text: M Lounge showcases a selection of Macallan whisky expressions.

findings.quote: For whisky enthusiasts, M Lounge presents an exclusive sanctuary, showcasing an exceptional selection of Macallan’s finest expressions for a truly refined experience.

claims.text: Xuan Spa uses Mekong Delta essences such as fresh herbs, local grains and fruits.

findings.quote: Our spa fully embraces the Mekong Delta’s essences, such as fresh herbs, local grains and fruits.

claims.text: An hour-long art tour on weekends showcases the hotel's most prized pieces.

findings.quote: On weekends at 5 p.m., an hour-long art tour showcases the hotel’s most prized pieces.

claims.text: A complimentary Chocolaterie tour on weekdays shows how the artisanal treats are made.

findings.quote: Or, you can join the complimentary Chocolaterie tour on weekdays at 3 p.m. to learn how they make the artisanal treats.

claims.text: The hotel stands on the former site of the Brinks Hotel Officers' Quarters, where US military officials lived during the Vietnam War.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Saigon stands on the former site of the Brinks Hotel Officers' Quarters, where US military officials lived during the Vietnam War.

claims.text: Square One received MICHELIN Guide recognition in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

findings.quote: With MICHELIN Guide recognition in 2023, 2024, and 2025, Square One stands as a refined expression of culinary craft and culture.

claims.text: Square One has two open-concept kitchens, one for Vietnamese dishes and one for French brasserie classics.

findings.quote: It has two open-concept kitchens, where chefs create innovative Vietnamese dishes in one and French brasserie classics in the other.

claims.text: The Magic Table is a dining experience led by Thommy Ten and Amelie van Tass, known as The Clairvoyants, using 3D projection mapping.

findings.quote: A spellbinding dining experience led by Thommy Ten & Amélie van Tass, internationally renowned as The Clairvoyants, through the artistry of 3D projection mapping.

claims.text: Park Lounge serves afternoon tea from the Ercuis trolley and offers a Dom Perignon tasting.

findings.quote: it offers signature experiences such as elegant afternoon tea from the Ercuis trolley and the Dom Pérignon tasting.

claims.text: There is no lifeguard at the pool, and children must be accompanied by an adult at all times.

findings.quote: There is no lifeguard on duty, and children must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
